title: Rav Yosef bar Chavu
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Yoma 87a, raising a difficulty before Rabbi Abbahu. There, according to Hyman’s report of the Ein Yaakov reading, he states the rule that ten people are brought to a person's grave to ask his forgiveness. Yuchasin reads Rav Yosef bar Chavush Maya.

notes.text: The consulted Yoma paragraph names Yosef bar Chavu as questioner; the grave rule concerns a deceased person whom one wronged. Hyman attributes that rule to this speaker in Ein Yaakov’s reading. The full Chavush Maya variant is preserved as a name form.
The consulted Yoma text names Yosef bar Chavu in the exchange with Abbahu. The attribution of the grave rule and the longer name form are reported from Hyman’s cited editions.
